wingsGuide.title: How the wings work
paragraphs: Our wings are lightly dusted and sold by the pound. Bone-in wings come 8 to 9 pieces to the pound, boneless 8 to 10, and veggie wings 10 to 12.

You choose the flavours. For bone-in orders, 1 and 2 lb come in one flavour, 3 and 4 lb in two flavours, and 5 lb in three. There are 40 to pick from, from Honey Garlic and Buffalo to Bombay Blaze and Mango Firestorm.
